      "observations": [
        "All three owned paths and all 94 historical diff lines were read. Despite the subject's changelog focus, the patch also changes recurrence-rule classification and CalDAV upload/HTTP redirect access.",
        "supportsChangeLog replaces instanceof Ci.calIChangeLog with optional QueryInterface inside try/catch and Boolean conversion. It returns false for an absent provider, a false result or an exception. The comment specifically names add-on compartments. Actual constructor and refresh callers use the result for offlineStorage/replay sequencing; this is not a universal instruction to replace every instanceof.",
        "The recurrence branch instead adds an imported CalRecurrenceRule constructor and accepts either that implementation instance or a calIRecurrenceRule instance. It no longer performs an optional QueryInterface on the single positive rule before switching on its type. The default remains custom. The actual imported implementation constructor and the caller that loads repeat controls were checked.",
        "The redirect branch catches upload-interface/stream/Content-Type extraction errors and then prepares the new channel. Later HTTP QueryInterface calls remain required, so the catch does not make null channels supported. Request method and last redirect status are read from the actual old channel. The empty catch is broad; no claim is made that every upload body/header survives every redirect.",
        "Accepted source retains these three distinct interface forms. Its redirect path later has an additional cross-origin Authorization abort and direct verification, whereas the owned phase awaits session.prepareRedirect before NS_OK. That later credential/session behavior is separate from this interface-check patch.",
        "No tests or assertions change. No add-on, recurrence UI, cached-calendar replay or network redirect ran. The cross-compartment rationale is source/comment and historical context, not a reproduced runtime diagnosis. Comments and checks remain specific to their actual receivers and caller roles.",
        "Full primary2020215 current0–11/activity/footer was read from Parent's exact original, and D285667 full creation-to-final timeline plus both actual inline bodies were read from C3's original. There are no summary/test-plan edit histories. Retained sources and reader attribution stay unchanged.",
        "The reporter attributes the regression to interface checks across add-on compartments and requests QueryInterface. The author limits the changelog reversal to add-on providers, separately explains recurrence info may be a rule or date, and adds back guarded upload handling despite uncertainty about that redirect case. Actual owned source establishes the three different receiver forms; this does not adopt a universal QueryInterface/instanceof rule.",
        "The inline reviewer asks whether requestMethod is available without HTTP QI. The author points to earlier QI rather than adding another call; actual owned/current method contains explicit new- and old-channel HTTP QI before method copying. The earlier upload/header extraction catch remains a separate path, not proof of arbitrary redirect interoperability.",
        "The author's preference to reduce XPCOM for all-JS Calendar is scoped opinion, and claims that other cases are not add-on implementations are attributed. Uplift reports no automated coverage, Daily verified and Beta not verified, then beta approval/uplift; these are historical. No add-on compartment, recurrence edit, cached replay, redirect or test ran. Regressor2005770 and SeeAlso2020201 remain bounded unread locators."
